main.description: Waits up to about 25 seconds for any followed space to change, then says which did. It names no writer, revision or content: a client that sees a space change asks that space's authority for listRepos, where its access is checked. Each space has its own cursor. A space the caller may not follow comes back in denied and its cursor does not move; a space whose cursor is older than the notices the operator keeps comes back in reset and should be synced. A call that follows nothing returns head at once: a client reads head, syncs a space, then follows it from head. A procedure, not a query, because 200 space references do not fit in a request line.

head.description: The operator's newest notice cursor, to follow a space from once it is synced.

after.description: The cursor this space was last synced or answered at.

cursor.description: This space's newest notice: follow it from here once it is synced.
